Thus, COUNT(*) and COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT) would be the same in this schema. However, Q1 uses COUNT(*) and Q2 uses COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT), which in general are not equivalent across all possible database schemas. The difference may not manifest in this specific schema but could in others. To be safe, the queries are not fully equivalent in general SQL logic.
